columns.sub_zh: 对齐「只管存钱能几岁退」
对齐「站稳某档还会不会翻」

lessons.title_en: Start one year later, lose how much
lessons.blurb_zh: 同样每月存一笔，晚一年不是少 12 笔，是少一整段复利。
lessons.blurb_en: Same monthly deposit, one year late: you lose a whole compounding stretch, not twelve deposits.
body_zh: 很多人把「晚一年开始」当成小事。每月同样存一笔、年化同样一个数、目标年数不变——晚一年不是少存 12 笔，而是少了一整段从第 1 年到终点都在滚的利息。
这个计算器只回答一件事：晚 n 年开工，终点少多少；若还想追上原来的终点，每月要多存多少。
不替你算几岁能退（那是 RETIRE-002），也不扣通胀。按期末年金、名义年化。
body_en: Delaying one year feels small. Same monthly amount, same nominal return, same horizon — you don't just skip twelve deposits. You skip a stretch of interest that would have compounded all the way to the end.
This calculator answers one question: if you start n years later, how much is missing at the finish; and if you still want the original finish, how much extra per month.
It does not solve retirement age (that's RETIRE-002) and it does not deflate. Ordinary annuity, nominal rate.

lessons.title_zh: 通胀把购买力吃掉多少
lessons.blurb_zh: 名义余额和能买到的东西，不是同一个数字。
lessons.blurb_en: Nominal balance and what it still buys are not the same number.

lessons.title_en: 1% rate gap, how many times the finish
lessons.blurb_zh: 年化差一个点，拉长时间后不是差一个点。
lessons.blurb_en: One point of annual return is not one point at the finish.

lessons.blurb_zh: 取出规则是启发式，不是保证函。
lessons.blurb_en: A withdrawal rule is a heuristic, not a guarantee.

lessons.blurb_zh: 比的是利率，不是道德。
lessons.blurb_en: Compare rates, not virtue.

lessons.title_zh: 工资停了，现金流撑几月
lessons.blurb_zh: 备用金是月数，不是感觉。
lessons.blurb_en: Runway is a month count, not a feeling.

lessons.title_zh: 退休后支出不是一条直线
lessons.title_en: Retirement spending is not a straight line
lessons.blurb_zh: 前期、医护、遗赠，三段不是同一个斜率。
lessons.blurb_en: Go-go, medical, bequest: three slopes, not one.

lessons.title_en: How much wage social security replaces
lessons.blurb_zh: 替代率先算清楚，再谈缺口。
lessons.blurb_en: Replacement rate first, gap second.

lessons.title_zh: 每月多存一笔，能提前几年
lessons.title_en: Save a bit more, retire how many years sooner
lessons.blurb_zh: 边际的一笔，换的是时间不是奖状。
lessons.blurb_en: The extra deposit buys time, not a certificate.

lessons.title_zh: 名义收益 vs 真实收益
lessons.blurb_zh: 先减去通胀，再谈「赚了」。
lessons.blurb_en: Subtract inflation before you say you earned.

lessons.blurb_zh: 能立刻变成现金的位置，才叫备用。
lessons.blurb_en: It's a reserve only if it can become cash now.

lessons.blurb_zh: 中途抽走本金，后面的曲线要重画。
lessons.blurb_en: Pull principal mid-stream and the curve redraws.

lessons.blurb_zh: 002 的假设成立时很好；不成立时要看见。
lessons.blurb_en: RETIRE-002's assumptions are fine until they aren't — see the edge.

lessons.blurb_zh: 编辑规则和确定性不是同一件事。
lessons.blurb_en: An editorial rule is not certainty.

lessons.blurb_zh: 盘口是价格，里面掺了风险偏好和流动性。
lessons.blurb_en: A market price mixes beliefs, risk preference, and liquidity.

lessons.title_zh: 期望值为正也可能连亏
lessons.title_en: Positive EV can still lose a streak
lessons.blurb_zh: 均值不管路径。路径能把你打出去。
lessons.blurb_en: The mean ignores the path. The path can knock you out.

lessons.blurb_zh: 同一条新闻驱动的两个盘，不是两次独立机会。
lessons.blurb_en: Two markets on one headline are not two independent shots.

lessons.blurb_zh: 便宜的一边，往往是你没写进剧本的一边。
lessons.blurb_en: The cheap side is often the side you didn't write into the script.

lessons.title_zh: 市场共识 vs 你的信息差
lessons.blurb_zh: 先问「我知道什么是盘口还不知道的」。
lessons.blurb_en: Ask first: what do I know that the price doesn't.

lessons.blurb_zh: 80¢ 不是锁。五次里有一次反向。
lessons.blurb_en: 80¢ is not a lock. One in five still goes the other way.

lessons.title_zh: 赔率跳动是新闻还是噪音
lessons.blurb_zh: 没有新信息的波动，不要写成剧情。
lessons.blurb_en: A move without news is not a plot twist.

lessons.blurb_zh: 004 写成「会发生」之后，下一张骨牌才是文章。
lessons.blurb_en: After WEEK-004 treats it as will-happen, the next tile is the piece.

lessons.title_zh: 把 60¢ 当成 100¢ 会错哪
lessons.title_en: What breaks if 60¢ is treated as 100¢
lessons.blurb_zh: 主线可以按会发生写，预案不能删。
lessons.blurb_en: You can write the main line as will-happen. You cannot delete the other 40%.

lessons.blurb_zh: 两件都发生，是相乘不是相加。
lessons.blurb_en: Both happening is a product, not a sum.

lessons.title_zh: 校准：你说的 70% 真有七成吗
lessons.blurb_zh: 直觉馆要的是校准，不是勇气。
lessons.blurb_en: This hall wants calibration, not courage.

lessons.title_en: The other side: price of won't-happen
lessons.blurb_zh: Yes 和 No 加起来该接近 1，差的是费用和缝。
lessons.blurb_en: Yes + No should sit near 1; the gap is fees and the crack.

lessons.title_zh: 价格站稳 90¢ 还会翻吗
lessons.title_en: After 90¢ dwells, does it still flip
lessons.blurb_zh: 005 的问题原句。馆里先占位。
lessons.blurb_en: LOCK-005's original question. A slot in this hall, not the essay.

lessons.blurb_zh: 剩下的 10¢ 要付翻盘和等待。
lessons.blurb_en: The last 10¢ pays for both the flip risk and the wait.

lessons.blurb_zh: 价格站稳和时间耗尽，不是同一种锁。
lessons.blurb_en: A dwelt price and a burnt clock are different locks.

lessons.title_zh: 从 80¢ 到 90¢ 的最后一公里
lessons.blurb_zh: 越靠近结算，同样 10¢ 含义不同。
lessons.blurb_en: The same 10¢ means something else near resolution.

lessons.title_en: How the same series resolved before
lessons.blurb_zh: 图书馆要的是同类，不是故事。
lessons.blurb_en: The library wants the same series, not a story.

lessons.blurb_zh: 扫尾利润可能先被点差吃掉。
lessons.blurb_en: The sweep's edge can vanish into the spread.

lessons.title_zh: 提前兑现 vs 拿到结算
lessons.title_en: Exit early vs hold to resolve
lessons.blurb_zh: 锁住的是价格，不是你的持仓义务。
lessons.blurb_en: The price can lock without locking you in.

lessons.blurb_zh: 要看翻了的那些，不只看顺收的那些。
lessons.blurb_en: Count the flips, not only the ones that sailed in.

lessons.blurb_zh: 三档不是线性的安全。
lessons.blurb_en: Three rungs are not linear safety.

lessons.title_zh: 离结算越近，时间怎么衰减
lessons.blurb_zh: 同样的价格，剩余小时数不同，锁的硬度不同。
lessons.blurb_en: Same price, fewer hours: a different hardness of lock.

lessons.title_en: A lock made of both sides
lessons.blurb_zh: 同时持有 Yes/No，锁的是价差不是方向。
lessons.blurb_en: Holding both sides locks the spread, not the direction.

lessons.title_zh: 站稳一天 vs 站稳一周
lessons.title_en: Dwell one day vs one week
lessons.blurb_zh: 005 问的是站稳之后还会不会翻。多久算站稳，本身是参数。
lessons.blurb_en: LOCK-005 asks if it still flips after a dwell. How long counts as dwell is a parameter.

lessons.title_zh: 手续费会吃掉扫尾利润
lessons.blurb_zh: 剩下几分钱时，费率不再是小数。
lessons.blurb_en: When a few cents remain, the fee is no longer a rounding error.

lessons.blurb_zh: 不是每个站稳的价格都值得收。
lessons.blurb_en: Not every dwelt price is worth collecting.
